# Task Report Accepted

A response event reporting acceptance of a task report associated with a request. It inherits `requestId`, which correlates the response with that request.

As a `Response`, it represents an authorized report. Authority comes from authenticated input or the emitting document’s origin, not from the event’s name. The domain determines the permitted reporting party and outcome semantics.

The supplied definition does not specify acceptance criteria or downstream effects. Acceptance of the report does not by itself establish task completion or confirm an external outcome.
